Educational preview. Save captions and slides only with all participants’ consent and permission to save the materials. The app does not determine whether recording is lawful.

Image comparison and checking interval. Click “Done” to save changes.
Ниже порог — меньше повторов. Выше — бол: Niedriger — weniger Wiederholungen. Höher — mehr ähnliche Bilder.
Lower — fewer repeats. Higher — more similar images.
